753:t_168:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You seek a father in me? I'm more than willing.」

753:t_168:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's exactly it! You force your selfish good intentions on people and don't care one bit how we feel! That's what makes you the same!」

753:t_168:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「I'm not lonely! I have the Colonel and $$アムロ$$ and everyone!」

753:t_168:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「So I'll protect the world everyone lives in! By beating a selfish creep like you!!」

753:t_169:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... Your fight is over. Eternal peace will come soon.」

753:t_169:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If the universe perishes, there's no fighting at all... You're right about that.」

753:t_169:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But I won't accept it... That is not peace...!」

753:t_169:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I will ask. What is this peace you speak of?」

753:t_169:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Can you answer that, after fighting on as an agent?」

753:t_169:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I know someone far better suited to answer that.」

753:t_169:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So my fight is to protect that woman.」

753:t_169:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Eyes without a trace of hesitation... You have transcended everything...!」

753:t_169:8.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Final attack objective: $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_169:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... I leave the rest to you.)

753:t_170:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「God versus the God of Death... Quite a stylish situation, $$デュオ$$.」

753:t_170:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The fact that we're both just calling ourselves that makes it even funnier.」

753:t_170:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I am the real thing. At least, a being who holds the qualification.」

753:t_170:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then I'll make the same claim.」

753:t_170:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「To make those words real, I'm going to finish you off...! Get ready, you knockoff god!」

753:t_171:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$トロワ$$... Let me tell you your real name.」

753:t_171:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Everything about your parents, too. You could even call me omniscient and omnipotent.」

753:t_171:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What do you mean?」

753:t_171:5.en:
$$トロワ$$
「You boast of being omniscient and omnipotent, yet all you do is watch the universe collapse.」

753:t_171:6.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Compared to you, humans who stake their lives on the fight, powerless as they are, are far stronger.」

753:t_171:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're quite eloquent today.」

753:t_171:8.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It seems I'm glad, too, that defeating you will end the fighting.」

753:t_171:9.en:
$$トロワ$$
「You're going to vanish, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. The universe has no need of you.」

753:t_172:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$カトル$$... The war warped your gentle heart, didn't it.」

753:t_172:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But it's all right now. All the suffering and sorrow will be wiped out once, along with this world.」

753:t_172:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And then a new world will begin...」

753:t_172:4.en:
$$カトル$$
「We won't accept a world like that...」

753:t_172:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Are you saying you will go on living in this world full of sorrow?」

753:t_172:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「We don't throw sorrow away, we overcome it...! That is how people live...!」

753:t_172:7.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't let someone who can throw everything away as easily as you do play with life as they please!」

753:t_172:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「I will fight you! To protect all life!!」

753:t_173:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$五飛$$... For someone as pure as you to live in, this world is...」

753:t_173:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You would ignore a god!」

753:t_173:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Even if you are a god, you can't lead me astray!」

753:t_173:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「Watch, $$トレーズ$$! I will fight with my life on the line to protect this world!」

753:t_174:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't hand this universe's future over to a man like you!」

753:t_174:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ゼクス$$... no, $$ミリアルド$$. That is not something you, who stepped down from leadership of your own accord, have any right to say.」

753:t_174:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's right...! As you say, I am a coward who abandoned my own responsibility!」

753:t_174:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's why I will be the sacrificial stone! For the future of humanity!」

753:t_174:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A magnificent resolve. Though it will only be a death in vain.」

753:t_174:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even a sacrificial stone can turn the whole game if it lands in the right spot!」

753:t_174:6.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The future my friend $$トレーズ$$ entrusted to me! I will protect it, I swear!!」

753:t_175:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I have no intention of accepting a hideous being like you as a god!」

753:t_175:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're quite harsh, $$ノイン$$. Is that abuse because you won't admit your own powerlessness?」

753:t_175:2.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I admitted my powerlessness long ago...!」

753:t_175:3.en:
$$ノイン$$
「But let me teach you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Humans are those who can still fight for their pride, even so!」

753:t_175:4.en:
$$ノイン$$
「And as long as $$ゼクス$$ is here, I can fight! Wherever $$ゼクス$$ is, that is my battlefield!!」

753:t_176:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You don't have to push yourself, $$ヒルデ$$. You don't have to fight anymore.」

753:t_176:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Meet the end of the universe with a peaceful heart. Leave everything after that to me.」

753:t_176:3.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I can't nod along to words like that...!」

753:t_176:4.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Whether you're a god or not, you're still my enemy!」

753:t_176:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I will punish you. If you're going to reconsider, now is your only chance.」

753:t_176:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I'm not afraid...! I have $$デュオ$$... my friends with me!」

753:t_176:7.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I will fight with my life on the line for what I believe in! Because that is how I wish to live!」

753:t_177:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Vulgar creature...! To sink so low as to call yourself a god!」

753:t_177:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Stop putting on a brave front, $$ハマーン$$. Deep in your heart, you must hold me in awe.」

753:t_177:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Humans are the ones who overcome that. You, who declare yourself the supreme being, could never understand it...!」

753:t_177:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It can't be helped. To silence you, it seems I have no choice but to punish you.」

753:t_177:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I will silence you, too. By shattering that confidence of yours...!」

753:t_177:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「False god $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't let you do as you please with the world we live in, for the sake of your ego!」

753:t_177:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Learn it well! The power of humans, who hold infinite possibility!」

753:t_178:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Never thought I'd end up fighting a guy who poses as a god! It never crossed my mind back when I was in $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

753:t_178:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're satisfied now, aren't you, $$ギュネイ$$? Now meet your end with a peaceful heart.」

753:t_178:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Quit joking! Now that we've come this far, surpassing a god doesn't sound bad!」

753:t_178:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Colonel, $$フロンタル$$, they're all out of my sights now! What I have to beat is a false god possessed by delusions of grandeur!」

753:t_178:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Your cool ends here, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'm going to hit you so I can survive!!」

753:t_179:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アルト$$... You should know that your wings, which carry your feelings, also bear someone else's sorrow.」

753:t_179:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Trying to rattle me with words like that is pointless! A guy like you could never understand the bond between us!」

753:t_179:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It exceeds the understanding of me, a god?」

ミリアルド.evidence: Zechs' real name (ミリアルド・ピースクラフト in glossary); Advent uses the bare given name at 753:t_174:1

uncertain: 753:t_168:2: 父性 rendered 'a father in me'; 望むところだ = 'more than willing'.
753:t_168:4, t_178:3: bare 大佐 (Quess/Gyunei about Char) = 'the Colonel'.
753:t_169:6: その女 = 'that woman' (Relena, settled by Heero's next thought).
753:t_170:0: 死神 (Duo) = 'the God of Death' (no prior rendering found).
753:t_174:3/5: 捨て石 = 'discarded stone' (keeps the stone image of t_174:5).
753:t_172:2: 一度消滅する = 'wiped out once' (implies later rebirth).
753:t_174:1: bare ミリアルド uses proposed token $$ミリアルド$$ (Milliardo); glossary only has the full name.
